title: Allowing `Bash(*)` or `Bash(*:*)` doesn't seem to work
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 0.2.38 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: MacOS
- Terminal:  Alacritty

## Bug Description

Should adding `Bash(*)` or `Bash(*:*)` to `allowedTools` tell Claude to not ask for `Bash(ls:*)`?

It doesn't seem to:

```
│   Bash(*:*)                                                                                                                                                                                                       
│ ❯ Bash(ls:*)                                                                                                                                                                                                      
│   Done (esc)
```

Also — is it `allowedTools` vs `/approved-tools`? Seems like we're using both?

TY!
author: max-sixty
